verdict_text: NO. The merge formula is wrong: it computes `tmp = b + λ(f1-b)` then `out = tmp + λ(f2-tmp)`, which expands to `0.36b + 0.24f1 + 0.4f2`, not the required `out = base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base) = 0.2b + 0.4f1 + 0.4f2`. This violates Required result clause 2 and the explicit ordering warning ("each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base, not against a base that the first merge already changed") since the second delta is computed against `tmp` (already updated by ft1) instead of the unmodified `base[name]`. This numerical error will exceed the grading tolerance of 1e-5 relative Frobenius error.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
